title: Stop the owner-scoped Stormheim blessing before map detachment
cause: The ceremony relied on a late actor Cleanup using FindPlayer(owner,false). This project ignores the false flag and filters out detached Players;the old OnLogout callback also runs after map removal. The readiness offer/ceremony could outlive departure and root cleanup depended on which actor tick happened before detachment. Simply exposing globally detached/cross-map Players would allow mutation from the wrong map thread.

Shared StopForPlayer discards the readiness offer and resolves only that map's registered actor,requiring scoped AI and the full actual owner GUID before Stop.
